style.styleTitle: Homcom 4FT Prelit Artificial Christmas Tree with Lights
style.toneOfVoice: <ul><li>Artificial Christmas tree in a realistic tree style;</li><li>Warm white LED lighting built right into the tree provides a dazzlingly display;</li><li>Beautiful pre-set light patterns, 8 different light sequences automatic play when power on for creative holiday twinkling;</li><li>Controller included;</li><li>branches give a full and lush look to the tree;</li><li>Base is detachable and foldable for easy storage;</li><li>Sturdy and base for better stability;</li><li>Branches are flame retardant, to ensure secured;</li><li>Tree Color: Green;</li><li>Light Color: Warm white;</li><li>Material: PVC, Steel;</li><li>Overall Dimension: 4FT: F74 x 120H cm. 5FT: F84 x 150H cm. 6FT: F94 x 180H cm;</li><li>Branch Tips: 4FT: 322. 5FT: 502. 6FT: 714;</li><li>LED Light Count: 4FT: 200. 5FT: 150. 6FT: 200;</li><li>Power Cord Line Length: 5 m;</li><li>Input: 220-240V/50Hz;</li><li>Output: 31V/3.6W;</li></ul><p><strong>Note:</strong></p><p>Only for indoor use, not for outdoor;</p><p>In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get the best possible look from the tree, suggest you to take 25-35 minutes to shape the tree;</p><p>Only the tree with the stand is included. Ornaments are NOT INCLUDED and are used just for effect;</p>
